data.long_meaning: The name Sharomika is a combination of two words. 'Sharo' means 'peaceful' and 'Mika' means 'flower'. So the name Sharomika means 'peaceful flower'. The name Sharomika carries the meaning “Peaceful flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharomika usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
